tiers.everyday: The Belfry of Bruges has a carillon of 47 bells weighing about 27 tonnes together. Its biggest bell dates from 1680.
tiers.student: Visit Bruges gives 47 bells totalling about 27 t, mostly 18th-century, with a 1680 victory bell of 6 t and 2 m diameter. The belfry is part of UNESCO site 943 (1999, extended 2005), which records civic belfries as symbols of municipal freedom.

model.label: 3D uses the largest bell: victory bell of 1680, 2 m across, 6 t. Parametric profile scaled from the sourced diameter; the curve itself is a generic Western bell profile, not a scan.
